:::{#rem-quadratic-model-taylor}
#### The quadratic model and Taylor's theorem

When the second partial derivatives of $f$ are continuous,
@thm-taylor-mv says that $f(\vx + \stepvec)$ equals the expression for $q(\stepvec)$ in @def-quadratic-model
with the Hessian evaluated at a point between $\vx$ and $\vx + \stepvec$.

:::
